item.title: Patriots Catch-22: Super Bowl LX Recap, Up/Down Takeaways, Offseason Outlook
item.description: Tune in as Evan Lazar and Alex Barth recap the Patriots Super Bowl LX loss to the Seahawks. They discuss positive and negative takeaways, including the offensive line's performance, coaching decisions, run defense, and more. They reflect on the 2025 season as a whole and comment on the culture shift, locker room, and player development. Plus, they look ahead to the offseason, as the combine, draft, and minicamp festivities are set to kick off in the next few months.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: Leadership, Combine/Draft Prep, Free Agent Watch
item.description: Tune in as we officially turn the page to the offseason. We discuss leadership and the things Drake Maye could take away from the Super Bowl run and use towards growth on the field, sideline, and in the huddle. We talk filling the Patriots biggest needs with available free agents and discuss the players best fit for New England. Plus, we dive into draft prep as the combine is less than a week away.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: NFL Combine: Day 1, Prospects/Positions to Watch, Team News/Updates
item.description: Tune in as we cover day one of the 2026 NFL Combine. We open with a discussion about EVP of Player Personnel Eliot Wolf's combine-opening press conference and his comments on the draft, free agency, and building the 2026 roster. We discuss free agent buzz and who stands out as potential big-ticket and underrated acquisitions. Plus, we talk about the Patriots releasing RB Antonio Gibson and other current Patriots whose contracts remain unseen.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: Combine News, Free Agency Analysis, Team/League Updates
item.description: Tune in as we dive into the latest offseason news and topics. We recap the Patriots media appearances from this week and discuss what Eliot Wolf and Mike Vrabel had to say about their approach to the offseason. We talk about available free agents on both internal and external levels, and which players seem worth spending on. Plus, we talk league news, updates, and topics like trade rumors, the growing value of 'smart' head coaches, and more!

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 3/3: NFL Combine Recap/Analysis, Free Agent Forecast, Team/League Updates
item.description: Tune in as we discuss the latest and greatest inside Pats Nation and the NFL. We recap and analyze the NFL Combine and discuss our takeaways on who made the best cases in the media and drills. We talk about internal and external free agents, as the tampering period and the league's new year begin on Monday, March 9, and Wednesday, March 11, respectively. Plus, we talk about recent team and league news like trades, releases, and more!
